records.goal: Execute the fixed-model LCCB series through the Oracle OpenAI-compatible provider
records.approach: Call /chat/completions with urllib using Authorization and Content-Type only
records.root_cause: The LCCB runner did not match the repository's canonical upstream HTTP header contract. The canonical AI client sends Accept: application/json and an AgentOS browser-like User-Agent; the failing runner omitted both and the upstream returned 403.
records.recovery: Align the LCCB runner with the canonical AI client header contract and regression-test the emitted request headers.

records.goal: Freeze the Oracle capability manifest as part of the reproducible LCCB execution environment
records.approach: Run scripts/discover_agentos_node.py directly from a fresh isolated git clone without installing the package
records.root_cause: The script assumed repo-root importability supplied by an editable install or PYTHONPATH. Direct execution sets sys.path[0] to scripts/, so the agentos_node package was not importable in the isolated checkout.
records.recovery: Bootstrap the repository root into sys.path before importing agentos_node and regression-test execution from a different cwd with PYTHONPATH removed.
